'''Camp Gamma''' was one of five refugee camps established within the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] following an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I hear there are other camps in the quarantine zone but I don't know their location.|[[Trig Longo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Trig|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> an accident happened in an [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was secretly conducting dangerous scientific research to engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. The virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment and turned most of the people ins the area flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. The Empire promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the virus outbreak, mostly Imperial staff and prisoners, were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. They established five camps inside the area, [[Camp Alpha]], [[Camp Beta]], Camp Gamma, [[Camp Delta]] and [[Camp Epsilon]], in order to try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation,<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> albeit all rescue teams were attacked upon landing in the area and their members were killed before they could find the survivors.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The camps were named by the [[TIE pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]] who had managed to deliver radios from Camp Alpha to the other camp and had established communication between them.<ref name="SWG:DR" />

Camp Gamma was made of a few tents surrounded by a protective wall consisting of concrete slabs, large disabled devices and other waste materials. It was inhabited by a ragtag group of survivors made of Imperial troopers, ex-prisoners and soldiers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> and the defense was led by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Kyra 'Naa]]. Indeed, the camp came under regular attack from the zombies and the refugees had to struggle for their survival.<ref name="SWG:FWGC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Gamma Camp|Dathomir}}</ref> Other survivors included the Rebel soldier [[Tripp D'jek]]<ref name="SWG:DR" /> and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oona Wran]].<ref name="SWG:QZVCD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Quarantine Zone Virus Container Demolition}}</ref>

Several spacers later visited Camp Gamma during their journey in the Quarantine Zone and assisted the survivors in their fight against the undeads.<ref name="SWG:FWGC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camp Gamma was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Camp Gamma was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
